items.text: What is the cheesiest pick-up line that has actually worked on you?
Give the player on your left a compliment that makes them blush, in your best movie-hero voice.
What is the most romantic thing someone has ever done for you?
Whisper a pick-up line to the player on your right, then let them rate it out of ten.
What is your biggest turn-off on a first date?
Do a slow wink at each player, one by one, around the table.
Have you ever had a crush on someone you were not supposed to?
Re-enact a romantic movie scene using a cushion as your partner.
What is your best flirting move?
Describe your dream date in exactly ten words.
What is the most awkward moment you have had on a date?
Give a dramatic love confession to the nearest lamp.
Who was your first crush?
Write a fake dating-app bio out loud for the group, cheeky but PG-13.
What is the most attractive quality a person can have, in your opinion?
Let the group pick a love song, then sing one line of it to the player you find most charming, if they agree.
What was the best kiss you have ever had, described in one word?
Hand the player on your right a pretend rose and quote a cheesy romance line.
Have you ever sent a text you regret?
Do your best suave walk to the fridge and back.
What is the most flirty song on your playlist?
Share your best dating-app opener, then ask it to someone in the room.
What is the longest you have waited for a reply from someone you liked?
Read a cheesy poem about the person on your left, out loud.
What is one thing you would never do on a first date?
Give the player across from you three compliments, each more flattering than the last.
What is the most romantic place you have ever been?
Make your entrance into the room like a mysterious stranger.
What compliment always makes you blush?
Tell the nearest plant that it looks radiant today, with full sincerity.
Have you ever been caught doing something silly in front of a crush?
Let the player on your left choose your next pose, then hold it for ten seconds.
What is the most expensive date you have ever been on?
Give a twenty-second speech on why the group should go on a double date.
Which celebrity would you go on a dream date with?
Sing a fake love duet with the player on your right, if they say yes.
What is your love language?
Deliver a rom-com style goodbye line to the player across from you.
Have you ever had a secret admirer? What happened?
Describe your ideal partner in one sentence with a cheesy metaphor.
What is the cheekiest text you have ever received?
Demonstrate three flirting moves to the group, then rate yourself.
Would you rather date someone who makes you laugh or someone who makes you feel safe?
Hold hands with the person on your left for thirty seconds, only if you both agree.
Which song always puts you in a romantic mood?
Teach the group a slow-dance step and dance it with someone who says yes.
What is your favourite romantic movie scene?
Introduce yourself as a secret agent with a flirty codename.
Have you ever danced with a stranger?
Describe the most attractive thing about this room's decor, like an estate agent.
What is the biggest red flag you have ignored?
Say a sweet nickname to the player on your right in a whisper, and let them guess the word.
What is a flirting mistake you have made?
Re-enact the first meeting of two famous movie characters, with the group playing the roles.
What does your ideal lazy Sunday with a partner look like?
Say your best I'll call you line and see who in the room believes you.
Who did you have a crush on in school?
Walk to the window like a film hero, pause for drama, then return.
What is the boldest thing you have done for love?
Describe the room as a romantic film set, in one dramatic sentence.
